경력 개발 제도

중심으로 일정 기간 근무 시 이동 기회가 제공되며, 이동 경로에 따라 특정 직무 전문가로 성장할 수 있습니다.

supporting_quote: The Plan is a defined contribution plan covering substantially all domestic employees of Amgen Inc. (the Company or Amgen) and participating subsidiaries.
title: Amgen Retirement and Savings Plan — 2025 Form 11-K — claim-specific evidence
claim_evidence_proposition: The Amgen Retirement and Savings Plan is a defined-contribution plan covering substantially all domestic employees of Amgen Inc.; participating subsidiaries are mentioned but are not included in this claim.

supporting_quote: Unless an employee has voluntarily enrolled in the Plan or has declined to participate in the Plan within the first 30 days of employment, all newly eligible participants are automatically enrolled in the Plan, and contributions equal to 5 % of their eligible compensation are withheld and contributed to the Plan as pre-tax contributions; such contributions are automatically increased by 1 % per year until their contributions reach 10 % of their eligible compensation. Participants may elect to adjust, cease or resume their Individual Contributions at any time.
title: Amgen Retirement and Savings Plan — 2025 Form 11-K — claim-specific evidence
claim_evidence_proposition: Newly eligible participants who neither enroll nor decline within 30 days are automatically enrolled at 5%, with annual one-point increases to 10%; participants may adjust, stop, or resume contributions.

supporting_quote: Each pay period, the Company makes a non-elective contribution for all eligible participants, whether or not they have elected to make Individual Contributions to the Plan, equal to 5 % of each participant’s eligible compensation (Core Contributions) up to a maximu m of $17,500 in 2025.
title: Amgen Retirement and Savings Plan — 2025 Form 11-K — claim-specific evidence
claim_evidence_proposition: Each pay period, Amgen makes a non-elective core contribution equal to 5% of eligible compensation for eligible participants, up to $17,500 in 2025.

supporting_quote: Participants are immediately vested with respect to their Individual Contributions, Matching Contributions and Special Contributions, if any, and earnings and losses (hereafter referred to as earnings) thereon.
title: Amgen Retirement and Savings Plan — 2025 Form 11-K — claim-specific evidence
claim_evidence_proposition: Participants are immediately vested in matching contributions and related earnings or losses.

supporting_quote: In addition, the Company makes a contribution equal to amounts contributed by the participant as pre-tax contributions or Roth contributions, including such contributions designated as catch-up contributions, of up to 5 % of eligible compensation (Matching Contributions) up to a maximum of $17,500 in 2025.
title: Amgen Retirement and Savings Plan — 2025 Form 11-K — claim-specific evidence
claim_evidence_proposition: Amgen matches participant pre-tax or Roth contributions up to 5% of eligible compensation, capped at $17,500 in 2025.

supporting_quote: Subject to certain limitations (as defined in the Plan), participants may elect to contribute up to 30 % of their eligible compensation in pre-tax contributions, Roth contributions (in accordance with the Code), after-tax contributions or a combination of these types of contributions (together, Individual Contributions).
title: Amgen Retirement and Savings Plan — 2025 Form 11-K — claim-specific evidence
claim_evidence_proposition: Participants may elect pre-tax, Roth, after-tax, or combined contributions up to 30% of eligible compensation, subject to plan and IRS limits.

supporting_quote: Most of the Company's employees who work in the United States of America who have completed 90 days of service or belong to a union that has negotiated inclusion into the Plan are considered eligible for participation.
title: Leggett & Platt, Incorporated 401(k) Plan and Trust Agreement — 2025 Form 11-K — claim-specific evidence
claim_evidence_proposition: Most employees of Leggett & Platt Incorporated working in the United States are eligible after 90 days of service, or if represented by a union that negotiated inclusion.

supporting_quote: Company contributions are vested following three years of service with 1,000 hours completed, at which time, they will become 100 % vested.
title: Leggett & Platt, Incorporated 401(k) Plan and Trust Agreement — 2025 Form 11-K — claim-specific evidence
claim_evidence_proposition: Company contributions become fully vested after three years of service with 1,000 hours completed.

supporting_quote: The Plan also allows: • Employee rollover contributions. • Roth contributions. These contributions are made on an after-tax basis subject to the rules contained in the Internal Revenue Code (IRC). • Catch up contributions for participants age 50 and over. Catch up contributions are not eligible for a Company matching contribution.
title: Leggett & Platt, Incorporated 401(k) Plan and Trust Agreement — 2025 Form 11-K — claim-specific evidence
claim_evidence_proposition: The plan permits employee rollover contributions, Roth contributions, and catch-up contributions for participants age 50 and older; catch-up contributions are not matched.

supporting_quote: Participants are always 100 % vested in their employee contributions, rollover accounts, and qualified non-elective contributions (QNECs).
title: Leggett & Platt, Incorporated 401(k) Plan and Trust Agreement — 2025 Form 11-K — claim-specific evidence
claim_evidence_proposition: Participants are always fully vested in employee contributions, rollover accounts, and qualified non-elective contributions.

supporting_quote: Eligible employees may participate beginning on January, April, July, and October 1 after meeting eligibility requirements or on any special entry date according to the Plan.
title: Leggett & Platt, Incorporated 401(k) Plan and Trust Agreement — 2025 Form 11-K — claim-specific evidence
claim_evidence_proposition: Eligible employees may begin participating on January 1, April 1, July 1, or October 1 after satisfying eligibility, or on a special entry date.

supporting_quote: Company contributions, including eligible matching contributions of 50 %, are made at the discretion of the employer and in accordance with the Plan.
title: Leggett & Platt, Incorporated 401(k) Plan and Trust Agreement — 2025 Form 11-K — claim-specific evidence
claim_evidence_proposition: Eligible company matching contributions are 50%, are discretionary, and are made in accordance with the plan.

제도를 포함해, 출산 전후 휴가, 배우자 출산휴가, 유산·사산 및 난임휴가 등 생애주기별 돌봄 지원 제도를 운영하고
있습니다. 이와 함께 육아기 근로시간 단축, 육아휴직, 모유 수유 시간 보장 등 자녀 양육기 유연근무 제도를 통해 일·

title: KET Sustainability Report 2025 — 건강·주거·식사 지원 근거
claim_evidence_proposition: 정기 건강검진, 평택사업장 기숙사, 사내식당, 체력단련실, 주거 안정자금, 불우 사원 지원을 운영한다고 보고한다. 고용형태와 세부 자격요건은 출처에 명시되지 않았다.

supporting_quote:
임직원 복지 및 근무환경
복리후생
복지제도 운영
한국단자공업은 인간 중심 경영 철학을 바탕으로, 임직원의 복지 향상과 일·생활 균형을 지원하기 위한 다양한
제도와 지원을 운영하고 있습니다. 임직원 간 소통 활성화와 창의적 사고 촉진을 위해 동호회 활동비, 부서 단합회비,
문화 활동비 등을 지원하고 있으며, 휴양시설 제공을 통해 재충전의 기회를 마련하고 있습니다. 또한, 사내 도서관과
체력단련실 등 휴식과 건강관리를 위한 공간을 운영하여, 임직원이 건강하고 안정적인 근무환경 속에서 역량을
발휘할 수 있도록 지원하고 있습니다.

As of December 31, 2025, the Company and its subsidiaries employed 1,962 full time-equivalent employees. Our associates are not represented by a collective bargaining agreement, and we believe our relationship with our associates is strong.
Professional Development and Employee Engagement
Seacoast offers comprehensive training and development programs to provide professional growth opportunities and career paths for our associates, and offers tuition reimbursement to promote continued professional education. For example, the Seacoast Manager Excellence Program, which was recognized by American Banker, supports associates as they progress from individual contributor to manager, focusing on creating purpose, driving results, developing talent, and leading change. To ensure that we are meeting associates’ expectations, we conduct an Employee Engagement Survey each year. The results of the survey and the process of continuous improvement are discussed with the Board at least annually. In 2025, 95% of associates participated in the annual engagement survey, with an overall associate engagement score of 85%, which is 16 percentage points higher than similarly-sized companies, 12 percentage points higher than the Banking industry and 10 percentage points higher than the Finance industry benchmarks.
